newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo precious metals end mostly firm as yen slips.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo precious metals end mostly firm as yen slips.

text.p: TOCOM precious metal futures ended mostly firmer on Tuesday, as a slip in the yen against the dollar lifted values, traders said.
Only palladium ended lower, reflecting a slump in spot prices overnight as steady Russian supplies continued to outpace sluggish demand.
Spot prices for gold and platinum ended little changed from Monday's closing levels in Tokyo and New York.
TOCOM benchmark August 1997 gold settled six yen higher at 1,359 yen per gram, a fresh three-month high for a most-active contract. The remaining months ended two to six yen higher.
